about_the_game:
Into the Harmony is a psychological quest that transports you to a post-apocalyptic reality. After a series of catastrophes caused by the rise of artificial intelligence, humanity is on the brink of extinction, and many regions of the planet's surface have become uninhabitable.

In this world lives a girl named Sophia. One day, she wakes up and realizes she's become a hostage to her own memory: the past has been erased, and only vague images whisper of something important.

Now she must piece together her memories to understand what really happened — to the world and to herself.

Into the Harmony is connected to the Snowfall's Mystery universe.

Psychological and mysterious scenario

Dive into Sophia's story, piece together her memories, and uncover the secrets of the new world. What happened to the planet? Why did artificial intelligence rise? And what connection does she have to this catastrophe?

Exploring the World

Explore underground cities, secret bunkers, and abandoned laboratories. Clues are hidden in every corner: diaries, computer entries, and parts of ancient technology.

Gameplay

  • Interact with other survivors, each with their own personality and secrets;

  • Solve puzzles and complete minigames;

  • Look for useful items and keys to progress;

Atmospheric pixel art

Each scene conveys a unique mood, from longing for a lost world to fear of the unknown. Experience the inspiring pixel art and experience the realities of a new post-apocalyptic world.

Multiple endings

Your decisions matter:

  • How should you treat other characters?

  • What should you do with the information you find?

  • Which truth should you accept?

Your actions determine the outcome of the game.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Into the Harmony is a psychological quest set in a post-apocalyptic world after an AI uprising. Awakening with amnesia, Sophia must piece together her forgotten past to uncover a secret that ties her own fate to the destiny of humanity.
